flows.name: View a product and add/remove it from the detail page
steps: Click a product's view-details link on the inventory page
Observe the detail page shows the same name, description, and price as the grid
Click Add to cart — button changes to Remove, cart badge increments
Click Remove — button reverts to Add to cart, badge clears
Click Add to cart, then Remove again — the toggle stays consistent across repeated use
Click Back to products — returns to the full inventory listing

notes: Confirmed live: both the login click and the product-detail navigation are client-side route changes that settle page.waitForLoadState('networkidle') well before the React re-render that actually changes the accessibility tree — the click tool's own returned snapshot was repeatedly stale (still the previous page) until it was hardened to poll for a genuine snapshot change instead of trusting networkidle alone. The detail page reuses the inventory grid's data-test='inventory-item-name'/'inventory-item-price' attributes, but its Add to cart/Remove button always uses the generic data-test='add-to-cart'/'remove' rather than a product-specific id, since only one product is ever in view.
